paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是，人们都很在意别人怎么看自己。克莱尔拿自己的人生和老朋友比较，杰在卡梅隆面前感到尴尬，而格洛丽亚则拒绝承认自己可能是个糟糕的司机。

克莱尔见到了十五年没见的前同事瓦莱丽。克莱尔为了养育家庭离开了工作岗位，而瓦莱丽一直留在公司。起初，克莱尔以为瓦莱丽会羡慕自己的婚姻和孩子。随后她才知道，瓦莱丽已经成了公司高管，经常环游世界，还即将去巴黎担任一个重要职位。

克莱尔立刻反过来觉得，是瓦莱丽在看不起自己的生活。她把对方邀请到家里，因为她想展示自己的家庭生活有多么美好。

不幸的是，瓦莱丽偏偏在最糟糕的时刻来到家里。家里停了水，卢克把回收活动收集的一大袋瓶子撒得到处都是，整栋房子闻起来像酒馆。亚历克斯正在追一只老鼠，海莉和迪伦则在楼梯上大声争吵。菲尔为了挽救一笔重要的房屋交易，还被困在外面的移动厕所里。

瓦莱丽离开前说，克莱尔有一个很美好的家庭，但克莱尔仍然觉得自己丢尽了脸。她冲所有人发火，然后走出了家门。后来她回来时，看到全家人正围坐在桌前吃饭。没有人逼她郑重道歉，只是自然地给她腾出了一个位置。她也因此重新想起，自己当初为什么选择了现在的生活。

与此同时，杰勉强答应和卡梅隆一起打壁球。他对和一个同性恋男人共用更衣室感到不自在，总是想象卡梅隆会用不一样的眼光看自己。

换衣服时，两个人光着的臀部不小心碰到了一起。卡梅隆随口把这叫作一次“登月”，杰却怎么都放不下这件事，还输掉了第一局。他要求再比一次，并赢得了比赛。回到更衣室后，杰努力证明自己已经完全不介意了。结果他突然发现，站在自己身后的那个人根本不是卡梅隆，于是立刻只想尽快离开。

米切尔则在帮格洛丽亚处理一起车祸。他很高兴，因为他以为杰终于开始尊重自己这个律师。接着，曼尼悄悄告诉他，事故其实是格洛丽亚造成的。米切尔打电话给杰后才知道，杰早就清楚真相，只是自己不想面对格洛丽亚，所以才把儿子拉了进来。

米切尔试着告诉格洛丽亚真相，但她立刻开始防御，还把他这个律师开除了。后来，她重新回来，承认事故或许确实有一部分是自己的责任。不幸的是，她这时已经又出了另一场车祸，再次需要米切尔帮忙。

到了最后，和瓦莱丽精彩的人生相比，克莱尔的家依然显得混乱不堪。但当家人再次欢迎她坐回餐桌时，她知道，自己正待在最想待的地方。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about people worrying about how others see them. Claire compares her life with an old friend’s, Jay feels awkward around Cameron, and Gloria refuses to admit that she may be a terrible driver.

Claire meets Valerie, a former coworker she hasn’t seen in fifteen years. Claire left her job to raise a family, while Valerie stayed at the company. At first, Claire thinks Valerie is jealous of her marriage and children. Then she learns that Valerie has become a senior executive, travels around the world, and is about to take an important job in Paris.

Claire suddenly feels that Valerie is looking down on her instead. She invites her home because she wants to show her how great her family life is.

Unfortunately, Valerie arrives at the worst possible time. The water has been shut off, Luke spills a huge bag of bottles from his recycling drive, and the house smells like alcohol. Alex is chasing a rat, while Haley and Dylan are having a loud argument on the stairs. Phil is also stuck outside using a portable toilet while trying to save an important house sale.

Valerie leaves after saying that Claire has a beautiful family, but Claire feels completely humiliated. She yells at everyone and walks out. When she comes back later, the family is sitting around the table eating together. Nobody makes her give a big apology. They simply make room for her, and she remembers why she chose this life in the first place.

Meanwhile, Jay reluctantly agrees to play racquetball with Cameron. He’s uncomfortable about sharing a locker room with a gay man and keeps imagining that Cameron will look at him differently.

While they’re changing, their bare backsides accidentally touch. Cameron casually calls it a “moon landing,” but Jay can’t stop thinking about it and loses their first game. He demands a rematch and wins. Back in the locker room, Jay tries to prove that the whole thing no longer bothers him. Then he realizes that the man standing behind him isn’t Cameron, and he suddenly wants to leave as quickly as possible.

Mitchell is helping Gloria after a car accident. He’s pleased because he thinks Jay finally respects him as a lawyer. Then Manny quietly tells him that Gloria caused the accident. When Mitchell calls Jay, he learns that Jay already knew and only involved him because he didn’t want to confront Gloria himself.

Mitchell tries to tell Gloria the truth, but she becomes defensive and fires him as her lawyer. Later, she returns and admits that the accident may have been partly her fault. Unfortunately, she has already had another accident and needs Mitchell’s help again.

By the end, Claire’s home still looks messy compared with Valerie’s exciting life. But when her family welcomes her back to the table, she knows she’s exactly where she wants to be.
